newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: RAILWAY SEES OKAY OF SHARE CAPITAL BOOST.
newsitem.headline: RAILWAY SEES OKAY OF SHARE CAPITAL BOOST.

text.p: The director of Lithuanian Railway, Stasys Labutis, said on Friday he expected shareholders to approve an increase in share capital to 1.3 billion litas, a boost of 91.8 million litas.
"I expect that the general shareholders meeting will agree to boost the share capital of the company by 91.8 million litas to 1.3 billion litas," Labutis told Reuters by telephone.
The issue is due to be discussed at the shareholders' meeting which is scheduled to begin at 1400 local, 1200 GMT.
Lithuanian Railway posted a net profit of 9.4 million litas for 1996 compared to 53,200 litas a year earlier.
The company moved 29.1 million tonnes of cargo in 1996, an increase of 12.1 percent over 1995 figures. Passenger volumes fell by 1.1 million to 14.2 million.
